question: What technical engineering requirements and airport proximity clearances are mandatory for billboard construction permits?
answer:
For billboard construction permits, the following technical engineering requirements are mandatory:

1. A Sign Permit is required before any sign or signboard shall be constructed or erected [S1].
2. If the building/facilities/structures are required to install any or combination of the following, a Fire Safety Clearance (FSCR/FSCCR/FSMR) is necessary:
   - Wet standpipe system
   - Automatic fire suppression system
   - Automatic fire detection and alarm system [S2]

No specific airport proximity clearances are mentioned in the provided sources for billboard construction permits.

Citations:
- [S1] OCBD Pages from CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf | printed page 567 | chunk DEV120-OCBO-PDF0079-C001
- [S2] BFP-CITIZENS-CHARTER-2022.pdf | printed page None | chunk DEV120-BFP-PDF0001-C043

ground_truth: New Billboard applications require structural plans, design analysis signed by a civil/structural engineer, CPDO locational clearance, Certificate of Structural Stability, insurance policy, DPWH clearance (if along national highway), and CAAP clearance if within 2km of the airport.
